title: BoxplotSCI
text: demonstrate various functionalities, use dataset summarySCI::hemoglobin_data. dataset hemoglobin contains hemoglobin values 169 patients 9 different time points. time points column visit_nr coded numeric, time points column visit coded factor. column Arm indicates whether patient Arm Arm B.
code: library(summarySCI) data(hemoglobin_data) hemoglobin <- hemoglobin_data head(hemoglobin) #>    ID   Arm   visit visit_nr  hb #> 1 ID1 Arm B Cycle 9        9 132 #> 2 ID1 Arm B Cycle 8        8 130 #> 3 ID1 Arm B Cycle 7        7 135 #> 4 ID1 Arm B Cycle 6        6 140 #> 5 ID1 Arm B Cycle 5        5 139 #> 6 ID1 Arm B Cycle 4        4 138

title: BoxplotSCI
text: Now let us imagine want order treatment groups reversed.
code: boxplotSCI(data = hemoglobin,                    var = hb,                    order = visit_nr,                    group = Arm,                    main = "Boxplots for the two groups",                    legend_position = "topleft") hemoglobin$Arm <- factor(hemoglobin$Arm, levels = c("Arm B",                                                  "Arm A"))  boxplotSCI(data = hemoglobin,                    var = hb,                    order = visit_nr,                    group = Arm,                    main = "Reversed treatment order",                    legend_position = "topright")

title: BoxplotSCI
text: names two groups can customized using group_names (legend) group_names_short x-axis. order group_names group_names_short must match order levels(factor(data$group))
code: # back to original order hemoglobin$Arm <- factor(hemoglobin$Arm, levels = c("Arm A",                                                  "Arm B"))  boxplotSCI(data = hemoglobin,                    var = hb,                    order = visit_nr,                    group = Arm,                    group_names = c("Treatment (Arm A)", "Control (Arm B)"),                    group_names_short = c("A", "B"),                   main = "Customization of group names",                    legend_position = "topright")

title: BoxplotSCI
text: function can also used one group.
code: boxplotSCI(data = hemoglobin[hemoglobin$Arm == "Arm A", ], # Only treatment                   var = hb,                    order = visit_nr,                   main = "Only treatment group")

title: BoxplotSCI
text: function also accept time points given factors. case, user needs make sure factor correctly ordered.  Another equivalent alternative put numeric time points order labels visit.
code: hemoglobin$visit <- factor(hemoglobin$visit,                            levels = c("Cycle 1", "Cycle 2", "Cycle 3",                                        "Cycle 4", "Cycle 5", "Cycle 6",                                        "Cycle 7", "Cycle 8", "Cycle 9")) boxplotSCI(data = hemoglobin,                    var = hb,                    order = visit,                    group = Arm,                    group_names = c("Treatment (Arm A)", "Control (Arm B)"),                    group_names_short = c("A", "B"),                   main = "Time points as factor",                    legend_position = "topleft"                   ) boxplotSCI(data = hemoglobin,                    var = hb,                    order = visit_nr,                    visit = visit,                   group = Arm,                    group_names = c("Treatment (Arm A)", "Control (Arm B)"),                    group_names_short = c("A", "B"),                   main = "Time points as factor",                    legend_position = "topleft"                   )

title: BoxplotSCI
text: position size legend can easily adapted using arguments legend_position legend_cex, respectively. box can added around legend using legend_bty = "o".
code: boxplotSCI(data = hemoglobin,                    var = hb,                    order = visit_nr,                    group = Arm,                    # short names                   group_names = c("Treatment (Arm A)", "Control (Arm B)"),                    group_names_short = c("A", "B"),                   # Title                   main = "Hemoglobin over time",                    # Legend position                   legend_position = "bottomright",                   # Legend size                   legend_cex = 0.75,                    # Legend box                   legend_bty = "o"                   )

title: BoxplotSCI
text: color size boxes can customized using arguments col boxwex. distance boxes (two groups compared) can adjusted argument shift.
code: boxplotSCI(data = hemoglobin,                    var = hb,                    order = visit_nr,                    group = Arm,                    # short names                   group_names = c("Treatment (Arm A)", "Control (Arm B)"),                    group_names_short = c("A", "B"),                   # Title                   main = "Hemoglobin over time",                    # Col of boxes                   col = c("lightblue", "orange"),                   # Width of boxes                   boxwex = 0.2,                    #Space between boxes                   shift = 0.15,                   # Legend position                   legend_position = "topleft",                   )

title: BoxplotSCI
text: Various parameters related axes can customized using xlab, ylab, cex_lab, cex_axis, ylim y_ticks.
code: par(las = 1) boxplotSCI(data = hemoglobin,                    var = hb,                    order = visit_nr,                    group = Arm,                    group_names = c("Treatment (Arm A)", "Control (Arm B)"),                    group_names_short = c("A", "B"),                   # Title                   main = "Hemoglobin over time",                    # X axis label                   xlab = "Visits",                    # X axis position                   xlab_position = 0,                   # Y axis label                   ylab = "Score",                   # Size of axis labels                   cex_lab = 1.2,                   # Size of axes                   cex_axis = 1.1,                   # Size of number of patients                   cex_n_patients = 0.9,                   # Y axis limit                   ylim = c(80, 200),                   # Y axis ticks                   y_ticks = seq(80, 180, by = 10),                   legend_position = "topleft"                   )

title: BoxplotSCI
text: Lines can added using lines color type specified using col_lines lty, respectively.
code: boxplotSCI(data = hemoglobin,                    var = hb,                    order = visit_nr,                    group = Arm,                    group_names = c("Treatment (Arm A)", "Control (Arm B)"),                    group_names_short = c("A", "B"),                   # Title                   main = "Hemoglobin over time",                    # Col of boxes                   col = c("lightblue", "orange"),                   # X axis label                   xlab = "Visits",                    # X axis position                   xlab_position = 0,                   # Y axis label                   ylab = "Score",                   lines = c(90, 120, 160),                    # Col of lines                   col_lines = c("red", "grey", "red"),                    # Type of lines                   lty = c(2, 3, 2)                   )

title: summaryByVisit
text: demonstrate various functionalities function, create small dataset. three hypotetical lab-values: LDH, ANC Lymphocytes two categorical variables, grade stage. lab-value measured 10 time points (visits), can divided three visit groups (baseline, treatment follow-). addition, grouping variable called ‘arm’.
code: data<-NULL visit <- c(paste0(rep("Visit ", 10), rbind(c(1:10))),            paste0(rep("Visit ", 10), rbind(c(1:10))),            paste0(rep("Visit ", 10), rbind(c(1:10)))) data <- as.data.frame(cbind( visit, rnorm(30))) data<-as.data.frame(rbind(data, data, data, data, data)) data$visitgroup<- ifelse(data$visit %in% c("Visit 1", "Visit 2"), "Baseline", ifelse(data$visit %in% c("Visit 3", "Visit 4"), "Treatment", "Follow-up")) data$visitgroup<-factor(data$visitgroup, levels = c("Baseline", "Treatment", "Follow-up")) data$LDH<-rnorm(150) data$Lymphocytes<-rnorm(150) data$ANC<-rnorm(150) data$LDH[3]<-NA data$stage <- c(rep("II", 75), rep("I", 75)) data$stage <- ifelse(data$Lymphocytes>1.5, NA, data$stage) data$grade <- c(rep("IV", 50), rep("III", 50), rep("II", 25), rep("I", 25)) data$arm<- c(rep("Arm A", 70), rep("Arm B", 80))

title: summaryByVisit
code: summaryByVisit(data = data,          vars = c("LDH", "Lymphocytes", "stage"),          visit = "visit",           add_n = TRUE)

title: summaryTable
text: demonstrate various functionalities function use dataset survival::colon. dataset colon contains data 1858 patients one first successful trials adjuvant chemotherapy colon cancer. simplicity, focus recurrence , two treatment groups, four variable: treatment group (rx), sex (Male), age (age) extent local spread (extent). also add missing values variable extent.
code: library(survival) data(cancer, package="survival")  colon1 <-  colon %>%   group_by(id) %>%   slice(1) %>% # Select the first row within each id group   ungroup() set.seed(123) colon2 <- colon1 %>%   select(rx, sex, age, extent) %>%   filter(rx != "Lev") %>%   mutate(rx = if_else(rx == "Obs", "Control", rx),          extent = if_else(row_number() %in% sample(row_number(), size = round(0.1 * n())), NA, extent)) %>%    rename(Male = sex) %>%    mutate(extent = as.factor(extent)) head(colon2) #> # A tibble: 6 × 4 #>   rx       Male   age extent #>   <chr>   <dbl> <dbl> <fct>  #> 1 Lev+5FU     1    43 3      #> 2 Lev+5FU     1    63 3      #> 3 Control     0    71 2      #> 4 Lev+5FU     0    66 3      #> 5 Control     1    69 3      #> 6 Lev+5FU     0    57 3

title: Boxplot over time — boxplotSCI
text: data data frame tibble containing data plotted. var Name column data indicating measurement plotted. Supports bare quoted column names. order Name column data containing time points interest. time points can either numeric, character, factor. time points factors, factor levels must correct chronological order plotting. left empty, function assume single time point. character, need able ordered numerical logic. visit Name column data containing descriptive labels time points. Optional. group Name column data containing grouping variables (e.g., treatment arms). left empty, function assume single group. group_names character vector containing names groups displayed legend. order must match levels(factor(data$group)). Default NULL, falls back group names found data. group_names_short character vector containing short names abbreviations groups, displayed x-axis near patient counts. Optional. Defaults group_names. main Title plot. Defaults "" (title). xlab label x-axis. Default "Time" multiple time points, otherwise defaults "Group". ylab label y-axis. Default "Variable". ylim y-axis limits plot numeric vector length 2. Default NULL, adds 10% padding buffer data range. y_ticks numeric vector specifying explicit tick positions y-axis. Default NULL, calculates 5 evenly spaced ticks across data range. col character vector hex colors color names use boxes. Default NULL, automatically applies SCI color palette. cex_lab numeric value specifying font size main axis labels. Default 1. cex_axis numeric value specifying font size axis tick marks. Default 1. cex_n_patients numeric value specifying font size sample size labels numbers displayed beneath horizontal axis. Default 0.7. boxwex Scale factor width boxes. Default NULL, scales box flexibly size total timepoints groups. shift numeric value indicating distance adjacent boxes within timepoint cluster. Default NULL, dynamically sets spacing boxwex * 1.15. mar_custom numeric vector indicating plot margins used form c(bottom, left, top, right). Default NULL, dynamically calculates spacing stacked sample-size rows never clipped. xlab_line numeric value indicating margin line offset x-axis label. Default NULL, calculates adaptive offset based number groups. ylab_line numeric value indicating margin line offset y-axis label. Default 3.0. xlab_position Horizontal position coordinate adjustment sample size group headers left-hand margin. Default NULL, auto-aligns . lines numeric vector indicating vertical coordinates horizontal reference lines plotted. Optional. lty numeric vector length 1 length lines indicating line type plotted. Default 1 (solid). col_lines character vector length 1 length lines indicating color reference lines. Default "grey". legend_position Position legend box. Options include standard base R keywords (e.g., "topright", "topleft", "bottom") manual numeric coordinate pairs c(x, y). Default "topright". legend_offset numeric vector length 2 specifying inset nudge legend position away plot elements. Default c(0, 0). legend_cex numeric value specifying font element scaling size inside legend box. Default 1. legend_bty type box border drawn around legend. Allowed values "n" (transparent/border, default) "o" (standard box frame). missing_nr numeric character value indicating zero-count patient sizes x-axis displayed. Default 0. Can also set NA. color_time logical toggle switch enabling legacy timepoint colorization. Supports legacy use, , single timepoint, multiple groups used "timepoint" variable. set TRUE, treats timepoints individual categories,applying sequential coloring rendering matching tracking legend. Default FALSE.
